title: A worker or reviewer in a worktree reads its own worktree's kb, not the main checkout's, through the kb MCP server
goal: kb_mcp.py started with its working directory in a linked worktree of its own clone serves that worktree's kb (kb_status's kb_dir and commit are the worktree's), not the checkout whose script the server was registered with, so a worker or reviewer in a worktree reads the kb its branch holds: seen in the SP-wwacrsqr review, where the kb server, registered at local scope with the main checkout's absolute _tools/kb_mcp.py path, served a checkout 33 commits behind and missed the sprint's new articles until the reviewer fell back to rag.py (SP-wwacrsqr retrospective).

run:
import subprocess, sys, os, tempfile
d=os.path.realpath(tempfile.mkdtemp()); w=os.path.join(d,'wt'); ok=False
subprocess.run(['git','worktree','add','--detach','-q',w],check=True)
try:
    p=subprocess.run([sys.executable,os.path.abspath('_tools/kb_mcp.py'),'--status'],cwd=w,capture_output=True,text=True,env={**os.environ,'CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR':w})
    ok=('kb_dir: '+os.path.join(w,'kb')) in p.stdout.splitlines()
finally:
    subprocess.run(['git','worktree','remove','--force',w])
sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)

notes: Planned at the 2026-10-13 draft triage (sprint 3 of 15, "Freshness at lookup: revalidation counts, memos, ledger reads and status agree"): it serves the fitness tests of EP-gzr4mmkm: a lookup's verdict or the benchmark's measurement is wrong until it is fixed. Premise run 2026-10-13: kb_mcp.py --status run by this checkout's script with its working directory in a fresh linked worktree prints this checkout's kb_dir, not the worktree's: the check fails on the base (exit 1). Chosen route: the code answers from the session's checkout, not worker and reviewer briefs that name rag.py, which would touch rule-guarding files (the worker role file, the skills). Only a working directory in a linked worktree of the script's own repository redirects the server; a host project's session keeps the script's own kb. The test file is left out of the touches (the check runs the changed path and no test id is added): an existing assertion in test_live_kb.py that pins the old kb_mcp start stops the work with a report. Its start-time redirect must leave import kb_mcp inert, since test_live_kb.py imports the module.
